attempts.summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf (accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route for both all/default set to 0), applied at runtime with sysctl --system, then restarted node1 and confirmed via a changed boot_id and re-verified sysctl values that the hardening persisted across reboot.
